commitments.text: Canada Pumice must cause the Project to be designed, located, constructed and operated in accordance with the application that is comprised of a document entitled A Prospectus for the Nazko Lava Quarry of Canada Pumice, May, 1995.

Canada Pumice must set aside, as outlined in the development plan for the Project in Map 5, those areas indicated by the legend marked "reserve" and coloured yellow, in which no mining, mining related activities, or logging shall take place: along Lava Lake: the area south of Michelle Creek Forestry Road on the east side of the Lake to the perimeter of the parking lot to protect a rare plant called Woodsia Ilvensis (Rusty Cliff Fern); and the area on the north and west side of the Lake; the unlogged old growth fir area on the eastern side of the production area including the cave area.
